verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents a real-time tax calculation endpoint (POST /v1/tax/estimate) as its Level 2 integration, built for pricing tax at checkout before payment. Rates reflect nexus, product taxability, exemptions and the ship-to address, and an address suggestion/validation endpoint supports address-level input. Rooftop precision and checkout-grade speed are only implied by the 'address you are shipping to' wording and the checkout positioning. missing for 10: explicit rooftop/geocoded (vs ZIP) accuracy claim, documented latency or performance figures, independent or hands-on corroboration.
